script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE SPARK

INT. GYM - DAY

JAMES, 30s, a former high school basketball star, sweats profusely as he runs laps around the empty track. He wears a gray hoodie and matching joggers. In the distance, through the gym's large bay windows, children play on the basketball court.

JAMES
(to himself)
I used to be the king of this place.

Suddenly, a basketball bounces into the gym. It's followed by SAM, 20s, an eager young man. He's wearing a basketball jersey and sweatpants.

SAM
Hey, mister, you look like you could use some company. Want to play some hoops?

James hesitates, but eventually nods. They shoot hoops for a while, and James starts to open up to Sam.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

James and Sam sit across from each other, sipping coffee.

JAMES
I used to have everything. A promising career, a loving family, a community. Then, one day, it all just... vanished.

SAM
What happened?

James sighs.

JAMES
I made some bad decisions. I let my ego get the best of me. I thought I was invincible. But eventually, I was proven wrong.

Sam listens intently.

SAM
But you're not that person anymore, right? You've got a second chance here. What do you want to be now?

James looks thoughtful.

JAMES
I want to be someone who inspires others. Someone who helps young athletes avoid the mistakes I made.

INT. GYM - DAY

James and Sam are now coaching a group of children. They teach them the fundamentals of basketball and impart valuable life lessons.

JAMES
Remember, kids, basketball is just a game. But the lessons you learn on the court will stay with you for the rest of your lives.

Suddenly, a loudspeaker blares an announcement. A local college basketball scout has come to watch the children play.

INT. GYM - LATER

James and Sam watch as the scout selects one of the children, LUCY, for a tryout.

SAM
She's got what it takes, doesn't she?

JAMES
Absolutely. But more importantly, she's learned the values that will take her far in life.

INT. COLLEGE GYM - DAY

Lucy, now a college athlete, practices with her team. She looks determined, focused, and confident.

Meanwhile, James and Sam watch from the sidelines, proud of their impact on her journey.

JAMES
(to Sam)
We did this. We gave her the spark she needed to ignite her passion.

SAM
And we're not done yet. There are so many more kids out there who need our help.

James nods in agreement. They turn to leave, ready to continue their mission of inspiring and guiding the next generation.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
